stories.title: Christa Pike sobrevive a injeção letal, segundo testemunhas; ela seria a primeira mulher executada no Tennesse em 200 anos

en.title: Christa Pike survives lethal injection, according to witnesses; she would be the first woman executed in Tennessee in 200 years
en.summary: Tennessee authorities were unable to execute Christa Pike, who was convicted of murder in 1995, on Wednesday. The lethal injection was suspended for hours while courts reviewed a last-minute appeal in what would have been the state's first execution of a woman in 200 years.

stories.title: Mensagens mostram que Campos Neto convidou Vorcaro para encontro em casa quando presidia BC

en.title: Messages show that Campos Neto invited Vorcaro to meet at his home while presiding over the Central Bank
en.summary: Messages extracted by the Federal Police reveal that Roberto Campos Neto, former president of the Central Bank, invited Daniel Vorcaro from Banco Master to meet at his home in the interior of São Paulo.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao STF que afaste de Dino de casos relacionados a ele, a Lula e às eleições

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro asks the Supreme Court to remove Dino from cases related to him, Lula, and the elections
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense requested that the Supreme Court remove Minister Dino from cases involving the candidate, Lula, and electoral matters, arguing that Dino has a close relationship with the current president.

stories.title: Lula tenta conter abstenção, e Flávio Bolsonaro foca voto útil na reta final da campanha

en.title: Lula tries to contain abstention, and Flávio Bolsonaro focuses on tactical voting in the final stretch of the campaign
en.summary: In the final stretch of the first election round, President Lula seeks to mobilize elderly voters to reduce abstention, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro plans to use a televised debate to attract undecided and right-wing voters.

stories.title: STF tem precedente para manter investigação sobre Flávio Bolsonaro caso ele seja eleito

en.title: Supreme Court has precedent to maintain investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro if he is elected
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court may need to rule on how to proceed with investigations involving senator Flávio Bolsonaro related to the "Dark Horse" film and Banco Master if he wins the presidential election.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula vai explorar reportagens que ligam Flávio Bolsonaro a milícia em peça eleitoral

en.title: Lula's campaign will exploit reports linking Flávio Bolsonaro to militias in electoral piece
en.summary: President Lula's campaign will broadcast an electoral advertisement on Thursday using the theme "Flávio Bolsonaro, the militia candidate," featuring reports indicating links between the PL candidate and militia members.

stories.title: Menos de 24 horas após suspender execução de mulher, Justiça dos EUA autoriza injeção letal

en.title: Less than 24 hours after suspending woman's execution, US Justice authorizes lethal injection
en.summary: A US court authorized a lethal injection execution less than a day after a previous execution suspension was issued for a woman.

stories.title: TSE forma maioria para manter retirada de posts sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: TSE forms majority to maintain removal of posts about Our Lady
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court voted to uphold the removal of social media posts about Our Lady of Aparecida during the election period, maintaining a decision by minister André Mendonça that responded to a request from presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Mendonça muda voto no TSE para liberar post de Antonio Tabet sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Mendonça changes vote at TSE to allow Antonio Tabet's post about Nossa Senhora
en.summary: Minister André Mendonça, the reporting judge at Brazil's Superior Electoral Court, adjusted his vote to preserve an actor Antonio Tabet's publication related to posts involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede suspeição de Dino em casos sobre eleições, Lula e o próprio senador

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro requests recusal of Dino in cases involving elections, Lula and the senator himself
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team requested that Supreme Court President Edson Fachin declare Minister Flávio Dino ineligible to handle cases concerning the presidential candidate, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and the presidential race.

stories.title: Lula é risco econômico, Flávio Bolsonaro é risco maior

en.title: Lula is an economic risk, Flávio Bolsonaro is a greater risk
en.summary: The opinion piece compares President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro as political and economic risks.

stories.title: Mendonça muda voto e maioria do TSE vota para excluir posts que ligam Flávio a ação contra padroeira

en.title: Mendonça changes vote and TSE majority votes to exclude posts linking Flávio to action against patroness
en.summary: Minister Mendonça adjusted his vote, resulting in the Superior Electoral Court majority deciding to remove posts that connected Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to an action regarding Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Candidatos ao Senado recebem de partidos mais do que podem gastar

en.title: Senate candidates receive from parties more than they can spend
en.summary: Half of the R$ 429.6 million distributed to Senate candidates is concentrated in 50 candidacies. Eight candidates received amounts equal to or exceeding the spending limit set by electoral authorities.

stories.title: NOTA CONJUNTA SOBRE A RESOLUÇÃO CMN Nº 5.343

en.title: JOINT NOTE ON CMN RESOLUTION No. 5.343
en.summary: CMN Resolution No. 5.343 significantly modified rules applicable to investment funds in credit rights that acquire rights involved in judicial and arbitral proceedings.

stories.title: TSE limita alcance de decisões de Mendonça sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: TSE limits scope of Mendonça's decisions on Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: The Superior Electoral Court restricted the scope of Justice André Mendonça's rulings on social media post removals. The limitation applies only to content asserting that candidate Flávio Bolsonaro took actions to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's status as Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Inteligência institucional transforma riscos em vantagem competitiva

en.title: Institutional intelligence transforms risks into competitive advantage
en.summary: Institutional risks have become routine for Brazilian companies, with instability stemming from pandemic effects, political polarization, and geopolitical tensions. Regulatory, tax, and legislative decisions now occur in shorter cycles under greater political pressure.

stories.title: Governo reduz contenção do Orçamento em R$ 1,97 bilhão

en.title: Government reduces Budget containment by R$ 1.97 billion
en.summary: Brazil's Planning and Budget Ministry released 1.97 billion reais in previously frozen executive budget funds to comply with fiscal rules. The release includes 1.51 billion reais for ministry spending and 461.2 million reais for parliamentary amendments.
